description:
The 2022 Sunreef 80 Eco is an electric luxury sailing catamaran built by Sunreef Yachts. Solar panels are integrated into her hulls, flybridge structure, bimini and carbon mast, and under sail she keeps producing green energy through her hydrogeneration system.

Her two hulls offer a total living space of 340 m². The custom layout accommodates 8 guests in 4 cabins: the master, a large VIP cabin in the middle of the port hull and two identical guest cabins in the bows. On the main deck, the galley to port is fully equipped with restaurant-quality appliances and plenty of storage, while the saloon, cockpit and flybridge are finished in teak.

Propulsion comes from two 180 kW electric motors fed by a 475 kWh battery bank, alongside two Volvo D3 150 hp engines. Her sail wardrobe includes a 200 m² mainsail, a 155 m² genoa, a 340 m² gennaker and a 70 m² staysail.

Price reduced and located in Dubai. Contact Yacht Research for the full specification and a private viewing.
